notes: Progressive level-up requirements derived from lifetime points: 500 from levels 1–9; 1,000 from 10–24; 1,500 from 25–49; 2,000 from 50–99; above 100, increase by 500 points every 50 levels (100–149: 2,500; 150–199: 3,000; etc.). Player Card shows points within the current level and accessible progress. Scores, achievements, offline data and ranking logic are unchanged.
